note: Following the worked example in the step instruction for this chapter, the four karyokinesis stage sub-headings were kept as one subtopic 'Stages of mitosis'; cytokinesis (10.2.5) was kept separate as the book does. Heading numbers 10.1, 10.2 and 10.2.1 Prophase are absent from the input headings list even though 10.1.1 and 10.2.2-10.2.5 are present, so subtopic 3 is attributed to '10.2' on the strength of its sub-headings and of the step instruction's example; prophase text itself survives only as the fragment P08 ('Cells at the end of prophase...'), so there is no full prophase passage to give its own subtopic. The two blank figure passages P11 and P12 sit between the anaphase and telophase text and were placed in the mitosis-stages subtopic. The SUMMARY is split across P33 (cell theory and cell division), P34 (cell cycle phases) and P35 (meiosis as reduction division) and each went to the matching subtopic; EXERCISES (P36, asking cell cycle span, cytokinesis vs karyokinesis, interphase, G0) was attached to subtopic 1.
